what.text: This page follows refugees from Afghanistan living in Australia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4111 Afghan refugees in Australia, 0.2% of all refugees from Afghanistan.
Pakistan and Iran host the most Afghan refugees, followed by Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1991 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at 2199 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 11932, at the end of 2018; the main years of displacement in the data are 2001 to 2006 and 2012 to 2022.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Australia.
These are year-end totals for Australia only, reported to UNHCR.
